trap.label: nominalização
trap.wrong: The declining of participation worries the council.
trap.right: The decline in participation worries the council.
trap.why: Em português “o declínio da participação” aceita gerúndio substantivado. Em inglês, nominalize com o substantivo decline in, não com -ing + of.

fix.wrong: The erosion on trust is rapid.
fix.right: The erosion of trust is rapid.

fix.wrong: Is unclear whether the effect lasts.
fix.right: It is unclear whether the effect lasts.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com whether: “We do not know if it lasts.” (It is unclear…)
rewrite.answer: It is unclear whether it lasts.
